binary_role: same diagnostic build with profiling flag off and on
profile_channel: one aggregate scan_profile JSON record on stderr

phase_definitions.main_to_dispatch_ms: run entry to scan dispatch; excludes OS loader
phase_definitions.setup_ms: scan entry through argument, limits, terminal and cancellation setup
phase_definitions.scan_ms: wall duration inside scan::scan, including native scope admission
phase_definitions.json_encode_write_flush_ms: combined serialization and stdout writing/flushing, not pure encoding CPU

instrumentation_overhead.estimator: median of paired profiling-on minus profiling-off completion times

guard: same direct-artifact read/write restrictions; fresh owned HOME/TMP per invocation
invariants: No new filesystem actions or deleted safety checks
Default stdout JSON schema and information are unchanged
Fixture, staged binaries and denied controls remain unchanged
Original v1 and corrected v2 baseline data are separate from diagnostics
interpretation: Parent wall minus child phase durations is a mixed launch/loader/observer/finalization residual, not pure startup
Version-only and empty-scan cases are diagnostic baselines, not full workload performance
Profiling overhead is measured; it is not assumed to be zero
